title: Non-defining relative clauses · 非限定性定语从句
pattern: Noun, who / which / whose + clause, (comma before and after)
summary: 非限定性定语从句对名词作补充说明，前后用逗号隔开，不能用 that，去掉它句子的基本意思仍然完整。
explanation: **非限定性定语从句**只是对前面的名词作补充说明，去掉它，句子的基本意思依然完整。它与限定性从句最大的区别是**前后要加逗号**：My sister, **who lives in Canada**, is coming home next week.（我姐姐住在加拿大，她下周回家）。
非限定性从句中的关系代词只能是 **who、whom、whose、which**，**不能用 that**。先行词是人时用 who（作主语）或 whom（作宾语），表示“……的”用 whose，先行词是物时用 which：The phone, **which** I bought last year, is broken.
which 还可以指代前面的整个句子，相当于中文里的“这件事”：He failed the exam, **which** surprised everyone.（他没通过考试，这让大家都很吃惊）。中文常用“这/那”来承接，英语直接用 which 引出补充说明。
非限定性从句中的关系代词**不能省略**，这一点与限定性从句不同。例如 My uncle, is a pilot. 是错误的，应写成 My uncle, **who** is a pilot, ...（关系代词 who 作主语，不能去掉）。
非限定性从句多见于书面语，口语里也常用。写作时要注意逗号的位置：逗号必须成对出现，而且从句结束后也要有逗号，除非它处在句末。翻译时，如果中文是“……，他/它……”这样的补充说明，就要用非限定性从句。
mistakes: ✗ My teacher, that is from London, is kind. → ✓ My teacher, who is from London, is kind. 非限定性从句不能用 that，指人要用 who。
✗ Tom, lives in Shanghai, is my friend. → ✓ Tom, who lives in Shanghai, is my friend. 非限定性从句中关系代词不能省略，否则主语缺失。
✗ The bag, which I bought it yesterday, is cheap. → ✓ The bag, which I bought yesterday, is cheap. which 已经作宾语，后面不能再加 it。
✗ He lost his keys, that made him angry. → ✓ He lost his keys, which made him angry. 指前面的整件事时要用 which，不用 that。

examples.text: My sister, who lives in Canada, is coming home next week.
examples.translation: 我姐姐住在加拿大，她下周回家。

examples.text: The new museum, which opened last year, is very popular.
examples.translation: 这家新博物馆去年开放，非常受欢迎。

examples.text: Mr Wang, whose son is a pilot, lives next door.
examples.translation: 王先生住在隔壁，他的儿子是飞行员。
examples.note: whose 后面直接接名词 son。

examples.text: She passed the test, which made her parents very proud.
examples.translation: 她通过了考试，这让她的父母非常自豪。
examples.note: which 指代前面的整件事。

examples.text: Paris, which is famous for its art, attracts millions of tourists.
examples.translation: 巴黎以艺术闻名，每年吸引数百万游客。

examples.text: Mrs Chen, whom we met at the party, is a famous designer.
examples.translation: 我们在聚会上见到的陈女士是一位著名设计师。

exercises.sentence: My grandmother, ___ lives in the countryside, still grows her own vegetables.
exercises.translation: 我的奶奶住在乡下，她仍然自己种菜。
exercises.explanation: 非限定性从句指人且作主语，用 who；不能用 that。

exercises.sentence: The concert, ___ was cancelled, will be held next month.
exercises.translation: 那场被取消的音乐会将在下个月举行。
exercises.explanation: 先行词 concert 是物，非限定性从句用 which。

exercises.source: 这部电影很好看，它是去年拍的。
options: The film, which was made last year, is very good.
The film, that was made last year, is very good.
The film which was made last year, is very good.
The film, who was made last year, is very good.
exercises.explanation: 非限定性从句前后都要有逗号，指物用 which。

options: My cousin, who is a nurse, lives in Beijing.
My cousin, is a nurse, lives in Beijing.
My cousin, who lives in Beijing, is a nurse.
exercises.explanation: 缺少关系代词 who，应改为 My cousin, who is a nurse, lives in Beijing。

exercises.prompt: 把单词排成正确的句子。
exercises.translation: 我的父亲是司机，他很累。
exercises.explanation: who 引导的补充说明夹在两个逗号之间。

exercises.sentence: The film, ___ we saw last night, was very long.
exercises.translation: 我们昨晚看的那部电影很长。
exercises.explanation: 先行词是物，且在从句中作宾语，非限定性从句用 which。

exercises.sentence: He missed the bus, ___ made him late.
exercises.translation: 他错过了公交车，这让他迟到了。
exercises.explanation: which 可以指代前面的整件事；that 不能用于非限定性从句。

exercises.source: 李老师（她教我们英语）今天没有来。
options: Mrs Li, who teaches us English, did not come today.
Mrs Li, who teaches us English did not come today.
Mrs Li, that teaches us English, did not come today.
Mrs Li, whom teaches us English, did not come today.
exercises.explanation: 指人作主语用 who，且前后都要用逗号隔开。

exercises.prompt: 把单词排成正确的句子。
exercises.translation: 这家酒店靠近车站，是新开的。
exercises.explanation: which 从句 which is near the station 放在两个逗号之间。
